mentions.name: Mavo
mentions.description: Mavo is a family calendar and scheduling app that centralizes events like registration dates, birthdays, and game times. Events can be submitted via email, web, in-app, or text message and are added to the calendar automatically, with conflict detection and tracking of who is assigned to each event rather than just attendance. It aims to proactively flag potential issues such as rain or traffic, offers a built-in AI assistant with optional MCP connectivity to ChatGPT, Claude, or other agents, and provides an API, SDK, and CLI for custom integrations. There is an always-free tier.
mentions.problem: Keeping track of registration dates, birthdays, game times, and other family events across separate work and personal calendars is stressful for busy families with kids in school activities.
mentions.audience: Families with busy schedules balancing kids' school and activities alongside work and personal calendars.
mentions.source_excerpt:
I built Mavo to try and centralize that stuff and see if I can make it more proactive than just a calendar.

You send it your events via email, online, in-app, or text message even, and it puts it into your calendar for you, letting you know if there’s conflicts and keeping track of who is assigned to what, not just who’s attending or not. My goal is to have it proactively notify you when there’s potential issues like rain, traffic, or something else.
mentions.author: wetoastfood
